pages.name: home-light-rings
pages.probe: (() => { const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/history/"]')]; return { order: cards.map(c => c.querySelector('h3')?.textContent.trim()), rings: cards.map(c => { const p = c.querySelector('.radial-progress'); const d = c.querySelector('.w-2.h-2.rounded-full'); return { grade: p?.textContent.trim(), score: getComputedStyle(p).getPropertyValue('--value').trim(), ringColor: p ? getComputedStyle(p).color : null, dot: d ? getComputedStyle(d).backgroundColor : null }; }) }; })()

pages.name: detail-grade-a
pages.probe: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.radial-progress'); const caption = [...document.querySelectorAll('span')].find(s => /Score$/.test(s.textContent.trim())); return { ring: getComputedStyle(p).color, caption: caption ? { text: caption.textContent.trim(), color: getComputedStyle(caption).color } : null, title: document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent.trim() }; })()

pages.name: detail-navigation-no-stale
pages.probe: (() => { const first = document.body.innerText.includes('Hazelnut Spread'); const history = [...document.querySelectorAll('nav button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('History')); history.click(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { document.querySelector('a[href*="/history/5449000000996"]')?.click(); setTimeout(() => r({ sawFirstProduct: first, afterNavigation: { title: document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent.trim(), stillShowsPrevious: document.body.innerText.includes('Hazelnut Spread') } }), 1500); }, 1200)); })()

pages.name: settings-score-toggle
pages.probe: (() => { [...document.querySelectorAll('.join button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('App')).click(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r({ stored: localStorage.getItem('score_func'), buttons: [...document.querySelectorAll('.join button')].map(b => ({ text: b.textContent.trim(), accent: b.className.includes('btn-accent') })) }), 700)); })()

pages.name: home-dark-rings
pages.probe: (() => { localStorage.setItem('theme','dark'); document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme','dark'); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/history/"]')]; r({ theme: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme'), rings: cards.map(c => { const p = c.querySelector('.radial-progress'); return { grade: p?.textContent.trim(), ring: getComputedStyle(p).color, border: getComputedStyle(p).borderTopColor }; }) }); }, 400)); })()
